What HALO actually does

A personal Windows helper that brings audio transcription, selected-screen context and prepared references into a sentence-by-sentence reading overlay. This scene is an illustration; it doesn't record you or run HALO.

The actual project

Botato is my personal Path of Exile automation project: movement, combat and the state that connects them. This little pathfinder is an interactive illustration, separate from the game.

LIQUIDATION

what's in
the box?

Following liquidation sales to overlooked
hardware. GPUs included.

the hunt, in miniature

an unopened box. naturally, i'm interested.
What's behind the hunt

Company filings, liquidation catalogues, hardware checks and resale evidence. GPU flipping is part of this same pipeline. The aim is to find equipment worth buying, after fees and the risk of faulty parts.
